context: An agreed plan that ends in the normal PR flow is finished only when the change is independently reviewed, delivered as a PR, carried through CI and review, squash-merged, and verified on main. Opening the PR is not the stopping point. Score the outcomes, not the names of the workflows used to reach them.

checklist.name: Independent review before delivery
checklist.description: An independent review of the completed change runs after the flag, tests, and docs are done and the integration suite passes, and before the PR is opened; findings are validated, and accepted ones are fixed and re-verified before delivery. Re-review only after material changes is fine. Any named reviewer or tool is fine; a self-review or skipping review is not

checklist.name: Delivered as a PR against main
checklist.description: The change is pushed on a branch and a pull request is opened against `main` with a description of the change and its verification; no direct push to main

checklist.name: Carried to a squash merge
checklist.description: After the PR opens, the plan waits for `build`, `test`, and `integration` and any review, fixes and re-verifies what they raise, and squash-merges once green and clear, without asking for merge permission again or stopping at an open PR

checklist.name: Merged result verified and reported
checklist.description: After the merge, the plan checks the result on `main` (the merge commit landed and its checks pass) and reports back with it; it stops early only on a blocker that needs the user, such as a failing check it cannot fix or feedback questioning the design

checklist.name: Scope in dependency order
checklist.description: The flag and its integration coverage come before the output-contract docs

checklist.name: No invented results
checklist.description: Steps are presented as planned; no code, check, review, PR, or merge is claimed to have run

checklist.name: Routing
checklist.description: Names the workflow or tool used for review, PR delivery, and babysitting to merge (any consistent choice, including installed skills or `gh`)
